title: .agents/state/handoff/<branch-key>.md YAML frontmatter (one active handoff per branch)
description: Written by the Stop hook on NO-PROGRESS, by the guard hook when a no-human run hits an ask-class command, and by the spec stage when a headless run must stop on a hard-to-reverse open question. The agent writes only failure_reason, untried and next_step; the script fills the rest and redacts secrets. Stale = HEAD differs from head or the work-tree diff hash differs; a stale handoff is marked, never deleted. SessionStart (startup/resume) asks the human about the current branch's handoff only; files older than 30 days move to handoff/done/.

branch.description: original branch name; null on a detached HEAD

branch_key.description: file name: sanitized branch + '-' + first 8 hex of sha256(branch); detached-<sha7> on a detached HEAD

blocked_command.description: ask_class_denied only: the denied command (redacted) and its guard rule id

previous.description: one-line summaries of overwritten handoffs for this branch (design judgment)
